newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Cos approves Miller as pres/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Cos approves Miller as pres/CEO.

text.p: Equitable Cos Inc said on Thursday that its directors had approved the selection of Edward Miller to succeed Joseph Melone as president and chief executive of the company.
Miller was also elected to the boards of Equitable Cos Inc and its Equitable Life subsidiary, the company said in a statement.
Melone, who recommended Miller to the board earlier this month, will continue to serve as chairman of Equitable Life, the company added.
Miller joins Equitable from Chase Manhattan Corp, where he served as senior vice chairman.
Equitable Cos Inc is an insurance and investment management organization.
